## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 10 jul 2026 - 5 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Chris Collard_, 2 oct 2026, 1/5: "it's broken!!!"
            2. _Ryan Gonzalez_, 30 sept 2026, 1/5: "This app was working amazingly for years until the recent update. The biggest issue is that my check ins are getting missed. I've even had them scan it twice and it still doesn't register. This wouldn't be a big deal but without my proof of gym visits I can't get reimbursed at my job for the visits. It's very frustrating and I don't get why they broke an app that wasn't broken. Edit: to those struggling to find check-in history - you can find it by going into your my I club online portal"
            3. _AJey Calloway_, 18 jul 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined planet fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter planet fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
